text.id: Speedboat-nya lompat dari satu gelombang ke gelombang lain, dan tiap kali jatuh, rasanya kayak nabrak tembok.
text.en: The speedboat leaps from one wave to the next, and every time it comes down, it feels like hitting a wall.

text.id: Laki-laki jas kuning dapet penumpangnya. Gue. Speedboat-nya lompat dari satu gelombang ke gelombang lain, dan tiap kali jatuh, rasanya kayak nabrak tembok.
text.en: The man in the yellow raincoat gets his passenger. Me. The speedboat leaps from one wave to the next, and every time it comes down, it feels like hitting a wall.

text.id: Mesin pertama mati di tengah patok-patok. Mesin kedua batuk, terus diem. Terus gelombang yang lebih tinggi dari speedboat-nya dateng dari samping.
text.en: The first engine dies among the stakes. The second coughs, then goes quiet. Then a wave taller than the boat comes from the side.

caption.id: Gue inget dingin. Gue inget nggak bisa bedain atas sama bawah.
caption.en: I remember cold. I remember not knowing up from down.

text.id: Kapal nelayan nemu kita tiga jam kemudian, nempel di patok bambu. Gue bangun di rumah sakit di Pluit dengan dua rusuk retak dan Dinda yang nggak mau ngomong sama gue.
text.en: A fishing boat found us three hours later, clinging to a bamboo stake. I woke up in a hospital in Pluit with two cracked ribs and Dinda refusing to speak to me.

text.id: Waktu gue masih di ranjang, polisi nyampe ke Pari pas lautnya buka. Sama orang Bentang. Sekar dibawa pulang, "ditemukan dalam keadaan sehat".
text.en: While I was still in bed, the police reached Pari when the sea opened. With Bentang's men. Sekar was brought home, "found in good health".

text.id: Alat rekamnya hilang di perjalanan. Nggak ada yang tahu ke mana. Pak Hendra diperiksa tiga hari. Episode dua belas nggak pernah tayang.
text.en: Her recorder was lost on the way. Nobody knows where. Pak Hendra was questioned for three days. Episode twelve never aired.

text.id: Sekar dateng ke rumah sakit sekali. Duduk di kursi sebelah ranjang, nggak ngomong apa-apa. Terus pulang.{w} Kali ini gue yang telat. Dan yang nggak ngomong.
text.en: Sekar came to the hospital once. Sat in the chair by the bed, said nothing. Then went home.{w} This time I was the one who was late. And the one who said nothing.

summary.id: Raka menyeberang sebelum badai reda. Polisi dan Bentang sampai ke Sekar duluan, dan buktinya hilang di perjalanan.
summary.en: Raka crossed before the storm let up. The police and Bentang reached Sekar first, and the evidence was lost on the way.
